newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Banerj privatization auction set for Wed.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Banerj privatization auction set for Wed.

text.p: The privatization auction of Rio de Janeiro state bank Banerj will take place on Wednesday, Rio state Finance Secretary Marco Aurelio Alencar said.
"We will privatize the bank tomorrow, probably in the afternoon," Alencar told reporters shortly after a Senate approval of a deal resolving Banerj's pension and payroll-related debts.
Alencar said there are still some bureaucratic details to be settled before the auction takes place.
The Senate approval of a 3.08 billion reais loan to Rio state to cover Banerj's debts was key to pave the way for the bank's privatization.
The loan will be made by federal mortgage bank Caixa Economica Federal (CEF).
Rio state will sell Banerj for a minimum price of 310 million reais in a closed-envelope auction on the Rio de Janeiro Stock Exchange.
Four banks -- Bradesco, BCN, Banco Itau and Cia. de Investimentos Latino-Americana -- signed up for the auction.
